title: neottia ehrenbergii
intro: Neottia ehrenbergii, commonly known as Chinese orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid native to China. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as being used to treat various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Neottia ehrenbergii include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce pain and swelling, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Neottia ehrenbergii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
